epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of orphaned PRs for terminal tasks from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: Automatically close GitHub pull requests when their owning tasks transition to a closed terminal state

slices.title: Implement PR closure on task terminal state transition
slices.jtbd: When implementing the terminal status transition for this epic, I want to invoke the GitHub API to close the PR, so that orphaned PRs do not accumulate.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an open pull request, When its status transitions to a closed terminal state, Then the GitHub API is called to close the pull request.
Given a task with no associated pull request, When its status transitions to a closed terminal state, Then the transition completes successfully without attempting to close a PR.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the rate of orphaned PRs for closed tasks from 1 to 0

slices.title: Verify automatic PR closure on terminal task states
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to test the PR closure integration, so that the orphaned PR bug is demonstrably fixed across the system.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a unit test environment with a mocked GitHub client, When the terminal state transition occurs, Then the test asserts the PR close endpoint is called.
Given an integration test environment, When a task lifecycle reaches a terminal state, Then the API contract for closing PRs is correctly executed.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for PR closure logic on terminal state transitions from 0% to 100%
